I love this brand! It is so hard to find facial products in the US that is for sensitive skin. My skin was very inflamed. I only been using the product a few weeks and my skin is already starting to clear. Thank you for this great product. I am excited to try other products

Dokdo/Birch toners are imperative for me as well. Birch Juice moisturizing cream and Dokdo moisturizing cream are my favorites as well. Its all very, very good. You can't lose.

I have sensitive to fragrance, oily, dehydrated skin that is acne prone. The cleanser isn't harsh and has a light pleasing scent. My skin feels a little tight and dry right after cleansing, but I follow up with the Dokdo toner and birch moisturizer, which leaves my skin feeling soft and supple without making my skin oily. Acne-wise, it doesn't worsen my acne thanks to it controlling my oily skin, but doesn't help getting rid of my occasional monthly breakout. Definitely recommend if you have oily skin, and want your skin to feel moisturized without the greasy feeling. Will be purchasing again, along with their Pine line for acne! :)

I mostly liked this cleanser, the smell was nice and it felt nice on my skin. I wouldn't say it hydrated my skin a lot because I didn't notice any difference. It is a gentle cleanser and will not hurt your skin.

avis.titre: 150ml squeeze tube with a super cute illustration
avis.texte: 𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 150ml squeeze tube with a super cute illustration 🤩the tube creases easily with use but i don't mind that. 𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐭 it had a really mild citrusy scent (probably from the vitamin C?) when i first opened it but it's basically scentless now. 𝐜𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐮𝐫 / 𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 transparent gel that creates a light foam. 𝐦𝐲 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 i love this cleanser! a little goes a long way. i'm sharing it with my sister and we're still using it in about 6 months in. it works for all skin types. it's even gentler than the round lab dokdo cleanser (another one of my faves). it takes off sebum and sunscreen (not water/sweat-resistant) with ease. it doesn't strip my skin and actually makes it feel hydrated after cleansing. this did not irritate my skin even when i used it during eczema flare ups. i'd recommend it for other eczemates out there 🫡
